description: Build a ready-to-use Pool Gateway proxy URL (gw.proxies.sx, HTTP 7000 or SOCKS5 7001). Local, no network. Take proxyUsername and password from pool_get_my_credentials (a reseller passes a customer pak_ key as password). pool: "peer" is the main network (residential and mobile, most countries), "mbl" is carrier modems in US, GB, FR, NL, PL and GE (Georgia) only, "any" or "best" let the gateway choose. Rotation: sticky and hard both hold one device, auto5/auto10/auto20/auto60 move to another device on that interval, ondemand picks again on each new connection; sticky, hard and auto* only persist across connections with a sid. Sticky holds the device, not the IP: a mobile carrier can still change the exit IP. The result contains the password.

asn.description: Only use one network, by AS number

carrier.description: Carrier from pool_get_facets: the part of a carrier id before the |, for example tmobile

failover.description: What may replace a device that goes offline (gateway default: samecountry)

ipType.description: Only use one IP class: mobile (cellular carriers), residential (home broadband) or isp (static addresses on ISP-registered networks, hosted on servers). The isp class is served only when named here. "datacenter" is accepted as another name for isp.

isp.description: ISP name to match, for example comcast

password.description: Proxy password, or a pak_ key

proxyUsername.description: Bare proxy username, for example psx_abc123

sid.description: Session id: 1-64 characters, lowercase letters, digits and _. Other characters are removed.

state.description: State or region code from pool_get_facets, for example ny (preferred, not guaranteed)

strict.description: With sticky or hard: prefer the devices whose exit IP holds longest

name: pool_build_proxy_url
